name: logo
prompt: Create a finished ORIGINAL logo graphic on actual transparent background for a children Three Kingdoms battle soccer game. Wide 2:1 layout 1024x512. ONLY six Traditional Chinese characters in this exact order: 三 國 戰 鬥 足 球. They must read 三國戰鬥足球. Pay special attention the FOURTH character is 鬥 (traditional fighting), NOT 門, 闘, 鬧, or 斗. Bold highly readable playful brush lettering, red letter faces, thick gold edging #F5C542, chunky dark brown outline, a modest soccer ball flourish. Do not include people, warriors, castles, extra words or complex ornaments. Keep generous padding; entire logo visible. Transparent PNG. This is a title lettering asset, not scene art.

name: btn_red_pressed
